## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

<a name="paper-2410.07073v2-pixtral"></a><a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2410.07073v2#S3.T3">Pixtral 12B</a>                                8   64% ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇

## How to run it

### Ollama (recommended)

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~6.92 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/llama3.2-vision/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run llama3.2-vision:11b-instruct-q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~13.34 GB) `ollama run llama3.2-vision:11b-instruct-q8_0`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/meta-llama](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct)
